definitions.explanation: A glove with a single section for all fingers together and a separate section for the thumb. Refers to both winter mittens and kitchen oven mitts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ミトン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
⟦オーブン→オーブン：04674_oobun⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ミトン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please use an oven mitt when taking it out of the oven.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ミトン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}げ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧にくくて⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: For children, mittens are more practical than gloves because they're harder to take off.

notes:
Loanword from English "mitten." Refers to either cold-weather mittens or heat-resistant kitchen mitts. Always written in katakana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ミトン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to put on mittens
- ミトン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off mittens
- ⟦オーブン→オーブン：04674_oobun⟧ミトン: oven mitt
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}つかみ→鍋つかみ：22656_nabetsukami⟧ミトン: pot-holder mitt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧: glove (with separate fingers); the general term
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}つかみ→鍋つかみ：22656_nabetsukami⟧: pot holder — generic, may not be glove-shaped
- グローブ: glove (sports, work)
